title: Code Quality: Large proxy_handler function should be refactored
description: src/proxy.rs:62-802 contains a single 740-line proxy_handler function that handles too many concerns: validation, injection, transformation, upstream requests, response streaming, and usage tracking. This violates single responsibility principle and makes the code hard to test and maintain. Fix: Extract into smaller functions: validate_request(), apply_transformations(), send_upstream(), handle_response(), track_usage(). Consider using a middleware pattern.

title: Code Quality: Dead code and unused imports scattered throughout
description: Several files contain dead code that should be cleaned up: 1) src/transform/mod.rs:6 has #![allow(dead_code)] - should identify what's actually unused 2) Multiple #[allow(dead_code)] attributes on individual items suggest unfinished features 3) Several unused imports visible from cargo check warnings. Fix: Run cargo clippy, remove genuinely dead code, and add TODO comments for intentionally unused code that's planned for future use.

title: CLI: Add serve, key, and test subcommands with latency benchmarking
Bedrock: Handle regional model name prefixes (us., eu., apac.)
description: Bedrock uses regional prefixes like us.anthropic.claude-3, eu.anthropic.claude-3, apac.anthropic.claude-3 for cross-region inference. Need to properly parse and route these.

title: Plugin system for analyzer integration
Correctness: generate_unique_human_id can still produce duplicates
description: In src/keys/store.rs:328-357, generate_unique_human_id queries the database to check for duplicates, but there's a TOCTOU race between checking and inserting. Two concurrent key creations could both check for the same ID, both find it available, and then both try to insert. The database UNIQUE constraint will catch this, but the second insertion will fail. Fix: Handle the unique constraint violation in create_key and retry with a new ID, or use a transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE semantics.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Use thiserror for error types
description: Multiple error types manually implement Display and Error traits: KeyStoreError (src/keys/store.rs:535-553), TransformError (src/transform/mod.rs:53-76), KeyValidationError (src/keys/validation.rs:157-202), RateLimitError (src/keys/rate_limit.rs:320-344), CliError (src/cli.rs:960-978). Fix: Use thiserror derive macro for cleaner, more maintainable error definitions.

title: Bedrock: Support multiple AWS authentication flows
description: LiteLLM supports multiple auth flows: Web Identity Token (OIDC), IAM Role assumption, AWS Profile, Session Token, Access Key + Secret Key, Environment variables, and cross-account role assumption for IRSA. We should review and enhance our Bedrock auth.

title: Update config.toml example with word_lists_path option
Performance: ConversationStore eviction sorts all entries
description: src/state.rs:280-291 collects all entries into a Vec and sorts them to find oldest entries for eviction. This is O(n log n) on every insertion over capacity. Fix: Use a priority queue (BinaryHeap) or LRU cache structure for O(log n) eviction, or select-k algorithm for O(n).

title: Code Duplication: guess_mime_from_url and guess_image_mime duplicate MIME detection
description: src/proxy.rs:1427-1442 (guess_mime_from_url) and src/cli.rs:1446-1458 (guess_image_mime) both detect MIME types from file extensions with similar logic. Fix: Extract to a shared utility function in a common module, or use the mime_guess crate.

title: Testing: Missing integration tests for provider transformations
description: While there are unit tests for individual transformers, there are no integration tests verifying end-to-end provider translation. Specifically missing: 1) Round-trip tests: OpenAI->Anthropic->OpenAI should preserve semantic content 2) Streaming transformation tests with real SSE data 3) Tool call transformation across providers 4) Error handling when provider returns unexpected format. Fix: Add integration test module with mock servers that verify full request/response cycles.

title: Implement drop_params and modify_params configuration options
description: LiteLLM has drop_params (silently drop unsupported params) and modify_params (auto-add required params) patterns. Add similar configuration options for flexibility.

title: Correctness: Race condition in DailyLimiter.check()
description: In src/keys/rate_limit.rs:287-300, the check() function does fetch_add followed by a conditional fetch_sub. Between these two atomic operations, another thread could see the temporarily incremented count and incorrectly be rate-limited. Fix: Use compare_exchange in a loop to atomically check-and-increment, or use a Mutex for the entire check operation.

title: Provider Translation: Add tool schema conversion
description: Convert JSON Schema tool definitions to each provider's format: OpenAI functions, Anthropic tools, Google functionDeclarations.

title: Security: Rate limiter state not persisted across restarts
description: In src/keys/rate_limit.rs, all rate limiting state (RPM, TPM, RPD) is stored in-memory only. When the server restarts, all rate limit counters reset to zero, allowing clients to bypass rate limits by triggering a server restart (e.g., through a crash bug or OOM condition). Fix: Consider persisting rate limit state to SQLite alongside the key store, or at minimum log when rate limits reset due to restart.

title: Create src/keys/word_lists.rs with WordLists struct and loading logic
Anthropic: Filter empty text blocks from requests
description: Empty text blocks cause Anthropic API errors. Must filter them out before sending requests.

title: Provider Translation: Implement OpenAI response builder
description: Convert canonical streaming events back to OpenAI SSE format (data: {...}). This is what clients receive.

title: Performance: Broadcast channel clones every event for each subscriber
description: In src/state.rs:390, a tokio::broadcast channel is used for AnalysisEvents. Broadcast channels clone the message for each receiver, which for large JSON bodies in Request events can be expensive. With multiple subscribers (log backends, CLI watchers), memory allocation increases linearly. Fix: Consider wrapping AnalysisEvent in Arc to share the data, or use a different channel type like tokio::sync::watch for single-producer multi-consumer scenarios where receivers only need the latest event.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Needless clones in several hot paths
description: Several places clone data unnecessarily: 1) src/proxy.rs:567: headers are cloned from upstream response even when not modified 2) src/proxy.rs:100: provider_name is cloned multiple times in provider resolution 3) src/state.rs:178: ConversationEntry is cloned on every get() call. Fix: Use references where possible, or Arc for shared ownership without full clones.

title: Idiomatic Rust: ProviderType::from_str should implement FromStr trait
description: src/provider.rs:51-68 defines a from_str method but doesn't implement the standard FromStr trait. This prevents using str::parse() or other standard parsing patterns. Fix: Implement std::str::FromStr trait instead of or in addition to the inherent method.

title: Security: WebSocket connection lacks rate limiting
description: WebSocket connections in src/proxy.rs:1008-1172 (ws_proxy_handler) lack rate limiting. While HTTP requests validate virtual keys with rate limits, WebSocket connections could bypass these limits. Malicious clients could establish many WebSocket sessions without rate limit enforcement. Fix: Validate virtual keys and apply rate limits before upgrading WebSocket connections.

title: Code Duplication: Error response construction repeated throughout handlers
description: The pattern (StatusCode::XXX, Json(ProxyError::new(...))) is repeated many times in src/proxy.rs and src/api.rs. Similar pattern with KeyApiError in src/api.rs. Fix: Create helper functions like proxy_error(status, msg, type) -> Response or implement IntoResponse for error types.

title: Fix catch-all route syntax for axum 0.7
Provider Translation: Implement Anthropic response transformer
description: Parse Anthropic SSE events (content_block_start, content_block_delta, etc.) into canonical StreamEvents. Handle thinking blocks with signatures.

title: Provider Translation: Handle provider-specific compat quirks
description: Implement quirks: Mistral 9-char tool IDs, developer vs system role, max_tokens field names, empty content handling, tool result name field.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Replace allow(dead_code) with proper visibility
description: Many items have #[allow(dead_code)] attribute: src/provider.rs (ProviderInfo fields), src/config.rs (LogBackend::max_size), src/keys/validation.rs (ValidatedKey fields), src/state.rs (AnalysisEvent variants). Fix: Either make these items pub(crate), remove if truly unused, or add #[cfg(test)] if test-only.

title: Code Duplication: KeyPermissions defined in both keys/types.rs and cli.rs
description: src/keys/types.rs:43-82 defines KeyPermissions and src/cli.rs:887-903 defines a separate KeyPermissions struct for CLI serialization. These could diverge and cause bugs. Fix: Use the same type or create a proper DTO conversion, possibly with serde attributes to handle serialization differences.

title: Add mitmproxy capture status to service start/status commands
Transparent traffic capture via mitmproxy integration
description: Enable zero-config transparent interception of LLM API traffic by integrating with mitmproxy's local capture mode. mitmproxy handles cross-platform traffic interception (signed macOS Network Extension, WinDivert on Windows, eBPF on Linux), while Eaves handles provider translation, logging, analytics, and rate limiting. This allows capturing traffic from desktop apps (ChatGPT, Claude) and any application without client configuration changes.

title: Create mitmproxy addon script (eavs_capture.py)
description: Create Python mitmproxy addon that intercepts LLM API traffic and routes it through Eaves. Features: 1) Detect LLM API domains (api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, etc.) 2) Detect desktop app domains (chat.openai.com, claude.ai, etc.) 3) Set X-Original-Host header for Eaves to detect provider 4) Configurable Eaves host/port 5) Verbose logging option 6) Passthrough mode for debugging

title: Add X-Original-Host provider auto-detection to Eaves proxy
description: Modify proxy.rs to detect provider from X-Original-Host header when X-Provider is not explicitly set. This enables mitmproxy integration where requests arrive with original host preserved in header. Add detect_provider_from_host() function that maps hostnames to provider names (openai.com->openai, anthropic.com->anthropic, etc.)

title: Add capture mode to Eaves CLI (eavs capture)
description: Add 'eavs capture' subcommand that: 1) Checks if mitmproxy is installed, provides install instructions if not 2) Starts Eaves server if not already running 3) Launches mitmproxy with --mode local and the eavs_capture.py addon 4) Handles graceful shutdown of both processes 5) Options: --app <name> to capture specific app, --verbose, --passthrough

title: Support desktop app traffic passthrough (ChatGPT, Claude apps)
description: Desktop apps like ChatGPT and Claude use different endpoints than the API (chat.openai.com, claude.ai). These need special handling: 1) Capture for logging/analytics but may not need provider translation 2) Handle authentication differently (session cookies vs API keys) 3) May use WebSocket connections 4) Consider if we want to modify these or just observe

title: Document mitmproxy integration setup
description: Add documentation for mitmproxy integration: 1) Prerequisites (mitmproxy 10.1.5+, certificate trust) 2) Quick start guide 3) Configuration options 4) Troubleshooting (certificate issues, app-specific problems) 5) Platform-specific notes (macOS permissions, Windows admin, Linux eBPF requirements)

title: Add container/Podman network integration for AI agents
description: Support capturing traffic from containerized AI agents: 1) Document HTTP_PROXY env var injection method 2) Consider Podman/Docker network-level routing 3) Add example docker-compose/podman setup 4) May need Eaves to listen on 0.0.0.0 or container network interface

title: Auto-start mitmproxy capture mode from Eaves config
description: Add config option to automatically start mitmproxy with the eavs_capture.py addon when Eaves starts. Config options: [capture] enabled = true/false, mitmproxy_path = 'mitmproxy' (or full path), mode = 'local' or 'local:AppName', verbose = false. On eavs serve, if capture.enabled, spawn mitmproxy as child process and manage its lifecycle.

title: Implement mock backend mode for cost-free benchmarking
description: Add a built-in mock backend that responds instantly with realistic-looking responses. This enables: 1) Measuring pure EAVS proxy overhead without network/provider latency 2) Testing concurrent connection handling without API costs 3) Stress testing with thousands of requests. Design: Add --mock flag to bench command, or a mock provider type that returns canned responses with configurable latency.

title: Add word_lists_path to KeysConfig with XDG default
CLI service commands ignore port from config.toml
Fix config schema: add 'pretty' to logging.default enum
Correctness: inject_handler doesn't validate injection payload
description: In src/api.rs:16-31, inject_handler accepts any role string in the injection payload without validation. Malicious users could inject messages with invalid roles (e.g., 'tool', 'function') that might cause issues with downstream providers. Also, very long content strings could cause memory issues. Fix: Validate role is one of 'system', 'user', 'assistant' and add content length limits.

title: Run cargo check to verify word lists implementation
Correctness: proxy_handler swallows injection application errors
description: In src/proxy.rs:221-229, if apply_injections modifies the JSON body but the body doesn't have a 'messages' array, the function silently does nothing. This could hide configuration errors where users expect injections to work but they're being silently ignored. Fix: Return a warning or error when injections are present but can't be applied due to missing messages array.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Use of String where &str would suffice
description: Throughout the codebase, functions accept String parameters when &str would work and avoid unnecessary allocations. Examples: 1) ProxyError::new takes impl Into<String> but callers often pass string literals 2) Many struct fields use String where they're only read, not modified. Fix: Use Cow<'static, str> for error messages that can be either static or dynamic, and prefer &str parameters where ownership isn't needed.

title: E2E tests: Full proxy pipeline with mock server
description: Add end-to-end tests using a mock upstream server. Tests: 1) Request flows through proxy unchanged (passthrough) 2) X-Provider routing selects correct upstream 3) Context injection modifies request 4) Streaming SSE chunks are forwarded correctly 5) Non-streaming responses work 6) Error responses are forwarded 7) Conversation state is tracked 8) Logging captures request/response. Use wiremock or similar for mock server.

title: Transform tests: Cross-provider message fidelity
description: Add comprehensive transform tests to verify message fidelity across providers. Tests: 1) OpenAI -> Anthropic -> OpenAI round-trip preserves content 2) Tool calls transform correctly (ID format differences) 3) Thinking blocks convert to <thinking> tags when crossing providers 4) System messages handled correctly per provider 5) Multi-turn conversations maintain context 6) Image/vision content transforms (base64, URLs) 7) Streaming events map correctly between formats

title: CLI lacks clear error message when EAVS server is not running
Mistral: Implement tool_choice translation (required -> any)
description: Mistral uses 'any' instead of 'required' for tool_choice. Need to map this in the request transformation.

title: Security: HeaderValue::from_str unwrap can panic on invalid values
description: Several places use unwrap() on HeaderValue::from_str which can panic on non-ASCII or invalid header values: src/proxy.rs:1264 (apply_ws_auth_headers), src/proxy.rs:1269 (apply_ws_auth_headers), src/proxy.rs:1311 (apply_http_auth_headers). These could be triggered by malicious provider configs. Fix: Use unwrap_or_else with a fallback empty value or proper error handling.

title: Performance: Usage tracker spawns background task for every request
description: In src/proxy.rs:599-604 and 731-737, a new tokio task is spawned for every request to record usage after a 1-second delay. This creates task overhead and the 1s delay means rapid requests may not have accurate usage tracking. Fix: Use a dedicated usage recording channel/task that batches updates, or record synchronously for critical tracking.

title: WebSocket support for mid-stream injection
Bedrock: Only send Anthropic beta headers for Claude models
description: Sending Anthropic-specific beta headers to non-Claude models (Qwen, Llama) on Bedrock causes errors. Need to conditionally apply headers based on model.

title: Security: Image URL fetching allows SSRF attacks
description: In src/proxy.rs:1499-1530, the fetch_image_to_base64 function fetches arbitrary URLs to resolve image content for vision requests. This allows Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks where an attacker could: 1) Probe internal network services (http://localhost:..., http://169.254.169.254/...) 2) Access internal metadata endpoints (AWS/GCP metadata) 3) Scan internal ports. Fix: Add URL allowlist/blocklist, block private IP ranges and localhost, validate URL scheme is http/https only (already done), consider adding configurable allowed domains.

title: Provider Translation: Implement AWS Bedrock transformer
description: Handle AWS SigV4 signing, Bedrock-specific request format, and response parsing for Claude/Titan models

title: Stress tests: Concurrent connections and streaming
description: Add stress/load tests for the proxy. Tests: 1) 100 concurrent non-streaming requests 2) 50 concurrent streaming connections 3) Long-running streams (5+ minutes) 4) Rapid connect/disconnect cycles 5) Memory usage under load (no leaks) 6) Injection during active streams 7) Provider failover scenarios. Use criterion for benchmarks, tokio-test for async.

title: Security: WebSocket proxy doesn't validate origin header
description: In src/proxy.rs:1069-1283 (ws_proxy_handler), the WebSocket upgrade doesn't validate the Origin header. This could allow cross-site WebSocket hijacking where a malicious website makes WebSocket connections using a user's session. Fix: Add Origin header validation with a configurable allowlist of trusted origins, or require a special header for WebSocket connections.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Google response transformer
description: Parse Google GenerateContent stream into canonical StreamEvents. Handle thought parts with thoughtSignature.

title: Testing: Rate limiter tests don't cover concurrent access
description: In src/keys/rate_limit.rs tests, all tests run sequentially without testing concurrent access patterns. The race conditions identified in DailyLimiter.check() and TokenBucketLimiter.consume() wouldn't be caught by these tests. Fix: Add tests using tokio::spawn to simulate concurrent requests, and use loom or shuttle for deterministic concurrency testing.

title: Add function to download word lists from GitHub if not present
Azure provider: resolve env base_url + correct endpoint URL building
Code Duplication: Streaming response parsing duplicated in chat/tool_call/chat_with_image
description: src/cli.rs:629-646, 717-738, and similar code in tool_call all parse SSE streaming responses with identical logic: strip data: prefix, check for [DONE], parse JSON, extract delta content. Fix: Extract a common parse_sse_stream() helper function.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Error types don't implement Clone or PartialEq
description: TransformError (src/transform/mod.rs:53-63), KeyStoreError (src/keys/store.rs:665-672), and CliError (src/cli.rs:977-982) implement Display and Error but not Clone or PartialEq. This makes testing harder and prevents error comparisons in assertions. Fix: Derive Clone and PartialEq where possible, or implement manually for types containing non-cloneable fields.

title: Performance: get_by_human_id iterates entire cache
description: src/keys/store.rs:262-266 iterates all cached keys to find by human ID: iter().find(). With many keys this is O(n). Fix: Add a secondary index DashMap<String, String> mapping human_id -> key_hash for O(1) lookups.

title: Performance: KeyStore syncs to SQLite on every request
description: In src/keys/store.rs:386-396, the usage update writes to SQLite synchronously on every single request. Comment at line 385 acknowledges this: 'For now, we'll update on every request for simplicity'. Fix: Batch usage updates (e.g., every 10 requests or every N seconds) and sync periodically. Use a background task for async writes.

title: Security: Key hash lookup vulnerable to timing attacks in get_by_key
description: In src/keys/store.rs:362-365, get_by_key uses hash_key() then does a DashMap lookup. The hash computation itself is constant-time, but the subsequent HashMap lookup is not, potentially leaking information about which key hashes exist. While the hash_key function uses SHA-256 (one-way), an attacker with many requests could potentially determine if a specific key hash exists. Fix: Consider adding a small random delay to key validation responses to obscure timing differences.

title: Code Duplication: EavsClient API methods have repeated request/error handling
description: In src/cli.rs, methods like create_key, list_keys, get_key, revoke_key all follow the same pattern: build request with optional master_key header, send, check status, parse response. Fix: Extract a generic request_with_auth<T>() method that handles the common flow.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Anthropic request transformer
description: Transform canonical Context to Anthropic Messages API format. Handle x-api-key header, anthropic-version, cache_control, and tool schema conversion.

title: CLI test harness for manual provider testing
description: Add a simple CLI tool or script for manually testing providers through EAVS. Features: 1) eavs-test chat 'Hello' --provider anthropic 2) eavs-test stream 'Tell me a story' --provider ollama 3) eavs-test image path/to/image.png 'Describe this' 4) eavs-test tool-call --provider openai 5) Output shows: request sent, response received, timing, token usage. Could be a separate binary or a cargo xtask.

title: Provider Translation: Define canonical message types
description: Define canonical types: UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ToolCall, ToolResult, ThinkingContent, TextContent, ImageContent. These form the foundation for cross-provider translation.

title: Add vision/multimodal support for image inputs
description: Support image inputs in requests for vision-capable models. Design: 1) Parse OpenAI vision format (image_url with base64 or URL) 2) Transform to provider-specific formats (Anthropic uses source.data, Google uses inlineData) 3) Handle both base64 and URL inputs 4) Support image content blocks in messages array. This enables ingestr VLM processing via EAVS.

title: CLI loads repo ./config.toml instead of XDG config
Code Duplication: Provider config header resolution repeated
description: The pattern of resolving env: prefixed values in headers is repeated in src/proxy.rs:386-396 (HTTP) and src/proxy.rs:1082-1095 (WebSocket). Fix: Add a ProviderConfig::resolved_headers() method that returns fully resolved headers, similar to resolved_api_key().

title: Correctness: apply_injections inserts system messages in wrong order
description: In src/proxy.rs:1055-1065, when multiple system injections are applied, they're inserted at index 0 one by one, which reverses their order. If injections are [{role:system, content:A}, {role:system, content:B}], the result will have B before A. Fix: Either insert all system messages at once in the correct order, or track the insertion point and increment it.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Use derive_more or strum for enum utilities
description: ProviderType, AuthStyle, BudgetWindow enums have manual implementations for common patterns: from_str parsing (src/provider.rs:51-68), Display (various errors). Fix: Consider derive_more for Display, From, Into or strum for string conversion, reducing boilerplate.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Use typed newtypes for key identifiers
description: Key identifiers (key_hash, key_id, conversation_id) are all String, making it easy to confuse them. Locations: src/keys/types.rs, src/state.rs. Fix: Create newtype wrappers (e.g., KeyHash(String), KeyId(String), ConversationId(String)) to leverage the type system for correctness.

title: Add comprehensive provider integration tests
description: Create integration tests for each provider covering: chat completions (streaming/non-streaming), models endpoint, tool calls, system messages, multi-turn conversations, and error handling. Tests should be opt-in via environment variables.

title: Policy engine (rewrite, filter, deny rules)
Security: Master key comparison vulnerable to timing attacks
description: In src/api.rs:199, the master key comparison uses direct string equality which is vulnerable to timing attacks. An attacker could deduce the master key by measuring response times. Location: src/api.rs:178-205 (check_master_key function). Fix: Use constant-time comparison like the existing constant_time_eq function in src/keys/generation.rs:107-117.

title: Performance: DashMap iteration in get_by_human_id is O(n)
description: In src/keys/store.rs:373-378, get_by_human_id iterates over all entries in the DashMap to find a key by human ID. With many keys, this becomes slow. Fix: Add a secondary index (another DashMap) that maps human_id -> key_hash for O(1) lookups. Update the index when keys are created/deleted.

title: Code Duplication: apply_http_extra_headers and apply_ws_extra_headers are identical
description: src/proxy.rs:1276-1292 (apply_ws_extra_headers) and src/proxy.rs:1323-1339 (apply_http_extra_headers) are functionally identical, adding anthropic-version and http-referer headers. Fix: Unify into a single generic function or use ProviderType.apply_extra_headers() method which exists but is unused.

title: Integration tests: Real provider round-trips
description: Add integration tests that make real API calls to providers (gated behind feature flag or env var). Tests: 1) OpenAI simple chat completion 2) Anthropic via X-Provider header 3) Ollama local model 4) Streaming responses for each 5) Vision/image input (when eavs-gn9 is done). Run with: EAVS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 cargo test --features integration

title: Performance: Redundant JSON serialization on every request
description: In src/proxy.rs, the request body is serialized to JSON multiple times: first for injection application (line 106), then for model extraction (line 112), and again for upstream request (line 310). The body is parsed, modified, and re-serialized even when no modifications are needed. Fix: Only serialize once at the end, work with the Value throughout the handler.

title: Azure: Support Azure AD OIDC token exchange
description: LiteLLM supports OIDC token exchange for Azure AD authentication (tokens starting with oidc/). Add similar support for enterprise Azure deployments.

title: Security: Database path not validated for path traversal
description: In src/config.rs:747-755, resolved_database_path expands ~ to HOME but doesn't validate the path for traversal attacks. If the database_path config comes from an untrusted source (e.g., env var), an attacker could potentially write keys.db to arbitrary locations like '/etc/eavs/keys.db' or '../../../tmp/keys.db'. Fix: Validate the resolved path is within expected directories, or canonicalize and compare prefixes.

title: Provider Translation: Implement cross-provider message transform
description: When messages from one provider are sent to another: convert thinking blocks to <thinking> text tags, filter orphan tool calls without results.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Azure OpenAI transformer
description: Handle Azure-specific URL patterns, api-version query param, api-key header, and deployment-based endpoints

title: Provider Translation: Implement Mistral transformer
description: Handle Mistral quirks: 9-char tool IDs, tool result name field, empty content handling, thinking to text conversion

title: Correctness: CliConfig::from_config ignores config file errors
description: In src/cli.rs:450-469, CliConfig::from_config calls get_effective_port which loads config, but if config loading fails, it silently falls back to defaults. This means users might think their config is being used when it's actually being ignored due to a parse error. Fix: Log a warning when config loading fails, or propagate the error.

title: Anthropic: Auto-detect and add beta headers based on request content
description: LiteLLM auto-detects features like prompt caching, PDF support, computer use, file IDs, and MCP servers, then adds appropriate beta headers. Headers include: prompt-caching-2024-07-31, pdfs-2024-09-25, computer-use-2024-10-22, files-api-2025-04-14, mcp-client-2025-04-04

title: Normalize error responses to OpenAI-compatible format
description: Each provider returns different error formats. Normalize all errors to OpenAI-compatible format with consistent types: authentication_error, invalid_request_error, rate_limit_error, context_length_exceeded, content_policy_violation, etc.

title: Mistral: Clean tool schemas (remove $id, $schema, additionalProperties)
description: Mistral has restrictions on tool schemas. Must remove $id, $schema, and additionalProperties fields from tool definitions.

title: Correctness: Usage history written even when key cache update fails
description: In src/keys/store.rs:456-527, update_usage writes to usage_history table even if the cache lookup for the key fails (no entry in cache). The usage history record is orphaned without an associated cache update. While not critical (cache is rebuilt on restart), it creates inconsistency. Fix: Only write usage_history if the key exists in cache, or structure as a transaction.

title: Add model capabilities and pricing JSON database
description: LiteLLM maintains model_prices_and_context_window.json with pricing, context limits, and capability flags (supports_function_calling, supports_vision, supports_reasoning). Add similar static database for model info.

title: Security: Request body size unlimited - potential DoS vector
description: In src/proxy.rs:95, the request body is read with usize::MAX as the limit, allowing arbitrarily large request bodies which could lead to memory exhaustion attacks. Fix: Add a configurable maximum body size limit (e.g., 10MB default) in ServerConfig and return 413 Payload Too Large for oversized requests.

title: Documentation: API endpoints lack OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
description: The control API endpoints (/inject, /admin/keys, etc.) are not documented in a machine-readable format. Users have to read the source code to understand request/response formats. Fix: Add utoipa or similar crate to generate OpenAPI documentation from the handler types, and serve Swagger UI at /docs or /openapi.json.

title: Mistral: Handle name field restriction (only in tool messages)
description: Mistral only supports the 'name' field in tool messages. Must remove it from other message types.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Google request transformer
description: Transform canonical Context to Google GenerateContent format. Handle role mapping (assistant->model), systemInstruction, and functionDeclarations.

title: Add concurrent connection benchmark (eavs test bench --concurrent)
description: Extend bench command to measure concurrent request handling. Metrics: 1) Max concurrent connections before errors 2) Requests per second at various concurrency levels 3) Latency distribution under load 4) Memory usage growth. Options: --concurrent N (number of parallel requests), --duration 30s (sustained load test), --ramp-up (gradually increase load).

title: Mistral: Filter empty assistant messages
description: Empty assistant content must be filtered before sending to Mistral API.

title: Provider Translation: Implement OpenAI request parser
description: Parse incoming /v1/chat/completions requests into canonical format. This is the input format clients send.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Inconsistent use of Option methods
description: The codebase mixes different patterns for Option handling: 1) Some places use .unwrap_or_default() (good), others use .unwrap_or(''.to_string()) (allocates) 2) Many .map().unwrap_or() chains could be .map_or() 3) if let Some(x) = opt { x } else { default } could be opt.unwrap_or(default). Fix: Standardize on idiomatic Option methods across the codebase.

title: Security: API key logged in debug traces
description: API keys could be exposed in debug logs. src/proxy.rs:478 logs full upstream URL which may contain API keys in query params. Request/response logging in AnalysisEvent captures full request bodies. Recommendation: Implement log redaction for Authorization headers and api_key query parameters, add --redact flag or log_redact config option.

title: Code Duplication: apply_http_auth_headers and apply_ws_auth_headers are nearly identical
description: src/proxy.rs:1241-1274 (apply_ws_auth_headers) and src/proxy.rs:1294-1321 (apply_http_auth_headers) contain duplicated auth header logic. The only difference is the header map type (http::Request vs HeaderMap). Fix: Extract a generic apply_auth_headers<H: HeadersMut> function that works with both types.

title: Add human-readable ID generation function
Performance: ConversationStore.maybe_evict sorts all entries for eviction
description: In src/state.rs:278-294, maybe_evict() collects all entries into a Vec and sorts them by last_accessed time to find the oldest entries to evict. With 10,000 conversations (the default max), this is O(n log n) on every insertion that triggers eviction. Fix: Use a min-heap or priority queue to track oldest entries, or use a simpler approximate LRU like removing any entry older than TTL rather than the oldest entries specifically.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Use Result combinators instead of match chains
description: Several functions have verbose match chains that could use Result combinators. Example in src/proxy.rs:248-256: nested map_err chains. Similar patterns in src/keys/store.rs:444-477 and src/aws_sigv4.rs. Fix: Use and_then, map, map_err combinators or the ? operator with proper error conversion for cleaner code.

title: Virtual API Keys System
description: Implement virtual API key system with SQLite storage, scoping (models, providers, rate limits, budgets), cost tracking, and self-provisioning endpoints

title: Correctness: TokenBucketLimiter.consume can go negative
description: In src/keys/rate_limit.rs:230-234, consume() does fetch_sub with tokens.min(available()). However, between the available() check and fetch_sub, another thread could consume tokens, potentially causing underflow (wrapping to a very large number). Fix: Use compare_exchange in a loop, or use saturating_sub which doesn't underflow.

title: Idiomatic Rust: Avoid clone() where borrow would suffice
description: Multiple unnecessary clones: src/proxy.rs:217 provider_lookup.resolved_name.clone() when &str would work, src/state.rs:391 config.state.clone() passed to ConversationStore but only parts used, src/keys/store.rs:253 v.clone() in map closure when ref would work. Fix: Use references or Cow where ownership isn't needed.

title: Provider Translation: Define canonical Context struct
description: Define Context struct with system_prompt, messages Vec, and tools Vec. This is the unified format all providers translate to/from.

title: Test chat 404 error - server not running on expected port
Anthropic: Implement tool_choice translation (required -> any)
Correctness: WebSocket close frame information lost in conversion
description: In src/proxy.rs:1303 and 1313, WebSocket close frames are converted with None instead of preserving the close reason/code. This loses valuable debugging information about why the upstream closed the connection (e.g., error codes, reason strings). Fix: Map the close frame payload properly: AxumWsMessage::Close(Some(cf)) -> TungsteniteMessage::Close(Some(CloseFrame{code, reason})).

title: Idiomatic Rust: Missing From implementations for error conversion
description: Several error types manually convert between each other using .map_err(|e| ...) instead of implementing From. Examples: 1) KeyStoreError doesn't impl From<sqlx::Error> 2) TransformError doesn't impl From<serde_json::Error> 3) CliError doesn't impl From<reqwest::Error> for all variants. Fix: Add From implementations to enable use of the ? operator directly without explicit map_err calls.

title: Integrate transformers into proxy for cross-provider translation
description: Wire up the transform layer to enable clients using OpenAI format to call Anthropic/Google/Azure/Mistral backends with automatic format translation. Parse incoming requests to canonical Context, transform to target format, and convert responses back.

title: Performance: Blocking synchronous file I/O in async context
description: src/cli.rs:695 uses std::fs::read() synchronously inside an async function, blocking the tokio runtime. Location: EavsClient::chat_with_image. Fix: Use tokio::fs::read() for async file operations to avoid blocking the executor thread pool.

title: Performance: StreamState uses std::sync::Mutex in async context
description: In src/proxy.rs:586, StreamState is wrapped in std::sync::Mutex and used inside an async stream map. This can cause issues because std::sync::Mutex blocks the thread while held, and if another task on the same runtime tries to acquire the lock, it can lead to deadlocks or reduced concurrency. Fix: Use tokio::sync::Mutex instead, or since the lock is only held briefly during chunk parsing, consider using parking_lot::Mutex which has better performance characteristics for short critical sections.

title: Correctness: Budget window reset logic may miss edge cases
description: In src/keys/store.rs:466-486, budget window reset checks compare dates but don't handle timezone edge cases properly. The comparison uses .date_naive() which strips timezone info, but window_start is stored with Utc timezone. If the server's local time differs from UTC, daily resets could happen at unexpected times. Also, monthly comparison compares only month/year, which could cause issues at year boundaries. Fix: Use chrono's duration-based comparisons consistently, or normalize all times to UTC explicitly.

title: Update mod.rs to export word_lists module
Use apply_auth and apply_extra_headers in proxy request building
description: The ProviderType methods apply_auth() and apply_extra_headers() are implemented but unused. They should be integrated into the proxy layer to centralize auth header handling. Also, get_provider() in AppConfig is unused - verify if resolve_provider() fully replaces it or if get_provider() should be removed.

title: Code Quality: Missing error context in many error conversions
description: Many .map_err() calls discard the original error and create a new one without context. Examples: 1) src/proxy.rs:128-148: body read errors lose original error details 2) src/keys/store.rs throughout: sqlx errors converted to strings without context 3) config loading errors lose file path context. Fix: Use error chaining with source(), or use anyhow/thiserror crates for proper error context.

title: Support fake streaming for providers without native streaming
description: Some providers/models don't support native SSE streaming (e.g., AI21 on Bedrock). Implement fake streaming that buffers the full response and emits it as chunks.
